invention.ref: Edward Lowe suggests granulated fuller's earth (bentonite clay) to neighbor Kay Draper in Cassopolis, Michigan
invention.ref_zh: 密歇根州卡索波利斯的爱德华·洛向前来借沙子的邻居推荐吸湿吸油的漂白土（膨润土）颗粒作猫便砂

mass_production.ref: Lowe packages clay in 5-lb bags branded 'Kitty Litter', selling them from the trunk of his car
mass_production.ref_zh: 爱德华·洛将袋装黏土命名为 Kitty Litter，从汽车后备箱和当地宠物店起步量产销售

popularization.ref: Thomas Nelson develops clumping cat litter from sodium bentonite clay in the United States
popularization.ref_zh: 生物化学家托马斯·纳尔逊研发出遇水结团的钠基膨润土猫砂，极大地简化了清理并普及至全球

locations.place_label_zh: 美国密歇根州卡索波利斯

sources.title: How Kitty Litter Changed the World — The Atlantic

summary_zh: 1947 年前养猫只能用泥沙或炉渣。爱德华·洛将吸水膨润土装袋制成 Kitty Litter，彻底解决了室内异味，使家猫从农场捕鼠动物变成现代纯室内陪伴宠物。
summary_en: Before 1947 indoor cats used sand or stove ashes. Edward Lowe packaged absorbent fuller's earth as 'Kitty Litter' in Michigan, transforming domestic cats into purely indoor companions worldwide.
summary_ja: 1947年より前、室内の猫には砂やかまどの灰が使われた。Edward Lowe はミシガンで吸水性のフラー土を「Kitty Litter」として売り、猫を完全な室内動物へ変えた。
